description: This file is a shell script that manages WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup) credentials and WPS trigger via button press events. It listens for WPS credential broadcasts, configures wireless interfaces accordingly, and handles button press events to initiate WPS sessions on wireless interfaces managed by hostapd and wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wps_catch_credentials
methods.description: Listens for incoming WPS credentials via ubus, parses JSON messages, and updates wireless configuration accordingly.
